input.producing_stage: Phase 2 frozen NLU (Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b, config v3)

field_usage_notes.requested_evidence_types: Prediction, not a routing decision (see nlu/schemas.py docstring and EVALUATION_CONTRACT.md 1.5). May be used as a deterministic input signal to Phase 3 source selection but is not itself the source-selection output.
field_usage_notes.entities.canonical_id: Only trustworthy when normalization_system is also non-None; an entity with both None is unnormalized.
field_usage_notes.original_query: Available only for free-text search-string construction where structured fields are insufficient; must not be used to re-derive intent/entities/constraints already computed by Phase 2.

output.description: A schema-validated execution plan (list of typed ToolCall objects) produced before any execution, and a per-call typed ToolExecutionResult list produced after execution, each correlated to its plan entry via call_id.

architectural_boundary: typed parameter generation (Phase 3, deterministic where possible)
safe execution (reuses existing tools/*.py HTTP+retry+rate-limit stack)
hard_rule: No LLM-produced arbitrary string may directly choose and invoke a Python function. Every ToolCall passes model validation, then registry lookup, then argument-schema validation, before any HTTP request.
undecided_at_contract_freeze: Whether Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b supports usable provider-native tool calling (Candidate B) - to be verified against current docs, not assumed.
Whether parameter generation per source is pure deterministic compilation or constrained-LLM assisted for free-text fields - decided by candidate comparison, not this contract.
